orders.confirmBodyShip: This holds {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} in stock for this order. Cancelling before you ship it puts them back.
orders.confirmBodyPickup: This holds {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} in stock for this order. Cancelling before you mark it ready for pickup puts them back.

orderStats.courierReturnedHint: to process — open each and return the order

trackLink.copyFailed: Could not copy - copy the link manually

dispatch.zoneHint: Pathao/eCourier match the address to a delivery zone automatically; if it can't, a matcher appears. Steadfast ships off the address line.

tracking.parked: {carrier} no longer recognises this parcel — it may have been deleted in {carrier}'s own panel. Automatic updates have stopped. Check it there, then return or update this order.

phone.copyFailed: Could not copy - copy the number manually

returnEvents.rest: Rest of the order received back — returned by you
returnEvents.parcel: Parcel received back — returned by you
returnEvents.items: Items received back — part of the order returned by you

manualStatus.title: Update delivery status
manualStatus.hint: This courier has no tracking API — what you set here is what your customer sees.
manualStatus.notePlaceholder: Add a note (optional) — shown to your customer
manualStatus.needsReturn: The parcel is marked returned, but the sale is still recorded. Use Return whole order above to restock the items and settle the refund.

manualDispatch.trackingLink: Your customer gets a clickable tracking link.
manualDispatch.noteHint: Shown to your customer on their order tracking.

orderRow.showBuyer: Show all orders from this customer

orderForm.nothingToFill: Nothing new to fill in — check the pasted text
orderForm.notReserved: Order created, but stock could not be reserved — confirm it manually

rowActions.deleteBody: The order is removed for good — this can't be undone. A record of the order number, customer and total is kept in case the customer asks about it later.

cancelDialog.rejectBody: The shopper is notified the order was rejected. This can't be undone.
cancelDialog.cancelBodyStock: Reserved stock is released back to inventory. This can't be undone.
cancelDialog.reportHint: Counted on your rejection report, so you can see what you are actually turning away.
cancelDialog.keptGoods: {amount} of this was collected against the goods. The cash stays in your account, but it is not counted in your order revenue — add it as other income if you want it counted as profit.

paymentPanel.title: Payment
paymentPanel.courierReturned: The courier reported this parcel returned — nothing to collect for the goods. Use Return whole order once it is back with you.
paymentPanel.awaitingCourier: Recorded automatically when the courier reports the delivery. If items came back, use Return items.

collectionSummary.title: Collection
collectionSummary.subtitle: What the courier handed over, and what accounts for the rest.

collectionDialog.returnItemsBody: Pick what came back. The rest is what was collected — anything short of {amount} has to be accounted for below.
collectionDialog.collectionBody: What was collected at the door. Anything short of {amount} has to be accounted for below.
collectionDialog.discountRequired: A reason is required — it is the only record of the concession.

handOver.title: Handed over in person
handOver.body: The customer got this order from you, not from a courier. It is marked delivered and paid to you in one step.
handOver.bodyCancelledBooking: The customer got this order from you, not from a courier. It is marked delivered and paid to you in one step — the cancelled courier booking stays on record, with no charge.
handOver.whyPlaceholder: Customer collected it from our office
handOver.whyHint: Saved to the order history so anyone can see why it was not sent.

markDelivered.title: {courier} says this parcel came back
markDelivered.body: {courier} reports it returned to you. If you have the parcel, close this and use Return whole order (or record what the customer kept). Mark it delivered only if the customer really received it.

metaPanel.title: Meta ads
metaPanel.counted: Counted as a purchase. Cancellations and returns after this point can't be taken back from Meta's reporting.
metaPanel.countedOn: Counted as a purchase on {date}. Cancellations and returns after this point can't be taken back from Meta's reporting.
metaPanel.alreadySent: Already sent to Meta — this can no longer be changed.
metaPanel.dontReportHint: For a personal, internal or test order.

reverseStatus.title: Move this order back
reverseStatus.body: The customer is not told about this — it corrects your own record.
reverseStatus.bodyReserved: The customer is not told about this — it corrects your own record. Going back to the first step also releases the stock this order is holding.
reverseStatus.whyHint: Saved to the order history so anyone can see why it moved.

createOrder.editBody: Change the lines, address or price before the order goes to the courier. Prices already agreed stay as they are unless you re-price.
createOrder.createBody: For an order taken on Messenger, WhatsApp, a post comment or the phone. It runs the same pipeline as a website order — courier, tracking and COD included.
createOrder.pastePlaceholder:
Rahim Uddin
01712345678
House 12, Road 4, Dhanmondi, Dhaka
createOrder.pasteHint: Fills only the fields it recognises, and never overwrites one you have already typed.
createOrder.channel: Where did this order come from?
createOrder.channelLocked: Where an order came from can't be changed.
createOrder.name: Customer name
createOrder.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number, e.g. 01712345678
createOrder.discountHint: An amount you agreed in the conversation. Applies on top of a coupon.
createOrder.repriceHint: Off by default, so changing one line never quietly reprices the rest against a total the customer already agreed.
createOrder.confirmNowHint: A chat order is already agreed, so this saves a second click.
createOrder.excludeMeta: Don't report this order to Meta
createOrder.excludeMetaHint: For a personal, internal or test order. Tick it here — confirming above sends the order to Meta straight away, so there is no chance to exclude it later.
createOrder.rejectedOne: One product can't be ordered online
createOrder.rejectedHint: Remove them, or list them on your store first. Everything else is priced below.

lineItems.title: Line items
lineItems.handedOver: Handed over in person — no courier, no courier charge.
lineItems.billedPaid: Courier charged {billed} · delivery margin {margin} (customer paid {paid} for delivery)
lineItems.estimateSent: Estimated courier cost {cost} — the courier's own charge replaces it when they bill.
lineItems.estimate: Estimated courier cost {cost} — the courier's real charge replaces it after dispatch, and weight and district can raise it.

prepayment.title: Record prepayment
prepayment.body: Money collected before shipping — a delivery-charge advance, or a bank transfer for the whole order. It is deducted from what the courier collects at the door.
prepayment.upTo: Up to the order total of {amount}.
prepayment.split: Booked as {shipping} delivery charge and {goods} toward the goods.

fraud.error: Something went wrong. Please contact EzyCore.
fraud.reports: {count, plural, one {# fraud report} other {# fraud reports}} from other merchants
fraud.noHistory: No delivery history for this number — treat as a new customer.
fraud.source: Delivery history for this customer's phone number.

fulfillment.title: Fulfillment
fulfillment.pickupHint: No courier — the customer collects from your store. Mark it ready for pickup with the status button above.
fulfillment.handedOverHint: The customer got this order from you, not from a courier.
fulfillment.noUpdates: No updates from the courier yet. Statuses refresh automatically every 30 minutes, or use Refresh above.
fulfillment.noCourier: No courier set up. Add one in <link>Store Settings → Couriers</link>.
fulfillment.reDispatchHint: The previous consignment was cancelled. Re-dispatching books a fresh consignment with the same courier or another.
fulfillment.shipHintStock: Sending it to the courier marks the order shipped and takes the held items out of stock.
fulfillment.shipHint: Sending it to the courier marks the order shipped.

itemsReturn.title: Return items
itemsReturn.bodyStock: For items the customer sends back after delivery. They go back into stock and the sale is reduced by their value. The delivery charge is not refunded. This can't be undone.
itemsReturn.body: For items the customer sends back after delivery. The sale is reduced by their value. The delivery charge is not refunded. This can't be undone.
itemsReturn.refundRequired: {amount} is money the customer already paid — choose where it goes below.
itemsReturn.toClearing: The courier still holds this money, so it comes back out of their account — no cash moves.
itemsReturn.reducesOwed: This reduces what was still owed; no cash moves.
itemsReturn.notTracked: Money is not tracked in your accounts, so pay the customer back yourself.

wholeReturn.title: Return the whole order
wholeReturn.bodyStock: Reverses the sale with a full return — stock is restocked and the goods refund is processed. This can't be undone.
wholeReturn.body: Reverses the sale with a full return — the goods refund is processed. This can't be undone.
wholeReturn.partHint: If only part of the parcel came back, use Return items instead.
wholeReturn.partialDelivery: The courier reported a partial delivery — the customer kept some items. Use Return items for the ones that came back.
wholeReturn.working: Working out what this return moves…
wholeReturn.refundRequired: {amount} of this is money the shopper has already parted with — choose where it goes below.
wholeReturn.toClearing: The courier reported this parcel returned, so this comes back out of their account — no shopper paid it and no cash moves.
wholeReturn.cancelsUnpaid: This cancels what was unpaid; no cash moves.
wholeReturn.doorHint: The courier holds it until they pay you, so it goes on their balance, not into your cash.

courierMoney.title: Courier charges
courierMoney.noCharge: The courier has not published a charge for this parcel. The dispatch quote stands until they do — it is the figure the courier balance subtracts meanwhile.
courierMoney.paidReturn: The customer refused the parcel but paid {amount} at the door. {courier} holds it until they pay you.
courierMoney.paidReturnCharge: The customer refused the parcel but paid the delivery charge at the door. {courier} holds it until they pay you.
courierMoney.partial: {courier} reported a partial delivery. The customer kept some items — record the ones that came back with Return items, not Return whole order.
courierMoney.partialCollected: {courier} reported a partial delivery and collected {amount}. The customer kept some items — record the ones that came back with Return items, not Return whole order.
courierMoney.clawback: {courier} paid you for this parcel before it came back, so it takes {amount} back out of a later payment.
courierMoney.owed: {amount} collected by {courier} — they owe it to you, less their charge, until you record their payment.
courierMoney.chargeOnly: {courier} will take its charge out of a payment for this parcel.
courierMoney.chargeOnlyAmount: {courier} will take its charge ({amount}) out of a payment for this parcel.
courierMoney.coveredOn: Covered by a payment from {courier} on {date}.

orderDetail.placedByAi: Taken by AI in a Messenger chat
orderDetail.placed: Placed {date} · {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} · {total}
orderDetail.terminal: This order was {status}. Any reserved stock was released back to inventory.
orderDetail.refundedStock: Stock was restocked and the payment refunded.
orderDetail.reversedStock: Stock was restocked and the sale reversed. Nothing was refunded.
orderDetail.reversed: The sale was reversed. Nothing was refunded.
orderDetail.partReturned: Part of this order came back.
orderDetail.partReturnedOn: Part of this order came back on {date}.
orderDetail.partStock: Those items were restocked and the refund settled against the collection.
orderDetail.part: The refund was settled against the collection.
